## About
Eagle Auto Glass is a local, family-owned auto glass shop in Magnolia, TX. We repair and replace windshields, door windows and back windows, and when a crack can be fixed without replacing the whole glass, we'll tell you.
A reviewer shared that Stephanie suggested coming in for a repair before paying for a new windshield. That's how we like to work with our neighbors: honest advice, fair prices and clean work.
Call us, send an email or request service online, and we'll get back to you within the day.

## Services
- Rock chip repair: Picked up a chip from a rock on the road? We can fix it, and you can get a $5 discount on rock chip repair. ($5 discount)
- Auto glass repair and replacement: Repair and replacement for your car's glass at affordable prices, from a local shop in Magnolia.

## FAQ
Q: How do I get a quote?
A: Give us a call at 346-812-9280 for a free quote, or use the Get Estimate form on our site.

Q: Can my crack be repaired, or do I need a new windshield?
A: A crack can sometimes be repaired without replacing the whole glass. Bring it by or call us and we'll take a look.

Q: How soon will you get back to me?
A: We return calls and respond to emails within the day.
